source: Geoffrey James, The Enochian Magick of Dr. John Dee (1984/1998), Book Three
note: Complete dictionary extracted from all 19 Angelic Calls. 631 unique words with frequency, pronunciation (James/Laycock reconstruction), English translations, and part-of-speech inference. Cross-references James position numbers.

entries.morphologicalNotes: "The earth" or "on the earth". Shortened form.
"The earth". See CAOSGO for genitive form.
"Of the earth". CAOSGI is "the earth". -O suffix may be genitive.
Means "time" or "while" (temporal). See also CAPIMAON ("number of time").
CAPIMAO + -N: "the number of time". Temporal suffix.
May derive from 'Christ' rather than being a native Enochian conjugation
Means "times" or "tyme". Appears in multiple calls.

meanings.english: The Thunders of Judgement and Wrath
The reasonable Creatures of Erth or Men

entries.morphologicalNotes: Related to MICAOLZ ("mighty"). G- prefix may indicate "in/with".
Related to MICAOLZ ("mighty"). G- prefix + -O suffix: "in power and presence".
Contraction of IAD + NAMAD ("God" + "knowledge"). Means "undefiled knowledge".

meanings.english: of him that is, was, and shall be crowned
the flames of the first glory
of him that sitteth on the holy Throne
for the beasts of the feild
the fires of life and encrease
in the brightnes of the heavens
within the depths of my Jaws

entries.morphologicalNotes: Contraction of TELOCH + VOVIN ("death" + "dragon"). The fallen one is the great dragon Coromzon.
Contraction of VONPHO + VONPH ("of wrath" + "wrath"). Emphatic redundancy.
Root for "dragon". See TELOCVOVIM, and 8.46 VOVINA.
